intent: 来点好看的科技感粒子背景

iterations.critique: Reads as a broken render, not a tech background: faint tiny speckles crawling in from the left, right half empty at t4, streaklets too small/dim to read as streaks or anything deliberate. The left-edge-source design starves frame coverage and the particle scale is below the visibility floor (the miner's sub-pixel lesson).

Coverage and brightness fixed — full-frame cyan field on dark blue, background-grade density. But the 'tech' read is still missing: streaklet clumps render as roundish dot clusters (motion per frame too small to elongate them), so it reads as dim blue snow, not data streams. Needs actual directional elongation.

Third direction also failed: aspect-7 glow spheres at 550 wind with motion blur render as giant smeared ellipses filling the frame wall-to-wall, with hard VERTICAL SEAM artifacts (sub-buffer edges) cutting the field — overpowering and visibly broken, worse than iter2's usable-but-bland dot field. Max-iters reached; best remains iter2 (5/10). Eval lesson recorded: for vague prompts the planner should adapt the closest CURATED library recipe (data-flow) wholesale instead of improvising particle-craft — three self-authored directions each missed taste.
